content: To let the NMT knows which language a certain source sentence is in and then can model the language information, we follows the conventions from BIBREF12 . We append language tags to every word in both source and target sentences of the mixed INLINEFORM0 corpus to indicate the language of the words. This technique shows the effectiveness in low-resourced scenarios BIBREF13 , BIBREF14 and our Japanese INLINEFORM1 Vietnamese is such a scenario.
